shared_memory_pools.description: RFC 0008 PR plan PR 4: named cross-agent memory pools with config-based ACL enforcement (RFC 0008 §H, Open Question 13). Deny-by-default — agents not in a pool's `readers` / `writers` lists raise SharedMemoryPermissionError. Sensitive pools (`sensitive: true`) cannot be published into via `MemoryFacade.publish_to_pool` regardless of writer ACL — RFC 0008 §H safety constraint #3.

type.description: Agent type: task (responds to assigned work) or persona (event-driven with autonomy)

instructions.description: Inline system prompt instructions for task agents. Mutually exclusive with 'instructions_file'. Either field is required when type=task.

instructions_file.description: Repo-root-relative path to a markdown file containing system prompt instructions. Must live under prompts/. Mutually exclusive with 'instructions'. The pattern enforces the prompts/ subtree at validate time as defense-in-depth; the runtime loader (agents.prompt_loader) is the authoritative deny-by-default control.

max_llm_calls.description: Maximum number of LLM calls per task (agent-level default for cascade)

max_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens per LLM call (agent-level default for cascade)

allOf.$comment: Conditional validation: each if-block requires 'type' to be present (required: [type]) so that v0.1 agents — which omit the 'type' field entirely — skip these conditionals and pass validation without 'persona' or 'instructions'. This is intentional backward-compatibility: v0.1 and v0.2 agent entries coexist in the same agents.yaml.

then.$comment: Persona agents must not declare task-agent prompt fields. Both 'instructions' and 'instructions_file' are silently ignored by create_persona_agent, which makes them an operator footgun; rejecting at validate time surfaces the misconfiguration before runtime.

allOf.$comment: Task agents must declare exactly one of 'instructions' or 'instructions_file'. 'oneOf' (rather than 'anyOf') catches the both-fields-set conflict at validate time; the runtime loader still enforces the same rule as defense-in-depth.

Safety net: if an agent configures persona-specific fields but omits 'type', require 'type' to prevent silent misconfiguration. Without this, a v0.2 persona agent missing 'type' would skip both conditionals above and validate without 'instructions' or 'persona' being required.

behavior.description: Structured behavioral dimensions (RFC 0005). Replaces free-text personality.traits / communication_style / decision_making. Individual dimensions are optional — omitted dimensions default to their middle value.

max_actions_per_tick.description: Maximum actions executed per tick cycle

idle_after_ticks.description: Reduce activity after this many consecutive idle ticks

memory.description: Memory configuration for persona agents (RFC 0005) and memory-enabled task agents (RFC 0008 PR plan PR 2).

enabled.description: RFC 0008 PR plan PR 2: opt-in flag for task-agent MemoryFacade. Deny-by-default — preserves existing stateless task-agent behaviour. Persona agents ignore this flag (their memory tiers are always initialised by initialize_persona_agents).

min_score.description: RFC 0008 PR plan PR 2: default relevance floor passed to MemoryFacade.retrieve_relevant. PR 2a raises the default from null to 0.20 (matches DEFAULT_EPISODIC_MIN_SCORE) so low-score entries do not cross the system-prompt trust boundary (OWASP LLM01). Set to null to disable filtering — only safe when downstream consumers re-rank or sandbox the entries.

episodic_cap.description: RFC 0008 PR plan PR 2: episodic-tier size cap for the eviction follow-on PR. Stored on the schema now so `memory.enabled: true` configs do not need to migrate when eviction lands.

ttl_low_importance_days.description: RFC 0008 PR plan PR 2: TTL (in days) for entries with importance < 0.3. Honoured by the eviction follow-on PR.

eviction_cadence_seconds.description: RFC 0008 PR plan PR 2: eviction-loop cadence. Honoured by the eviction follow-on PR.

db_path.description: Path to the shared SQLite memory database

interaction_idle_timeout_sec.description: Idle window (seconds) after which an open multi-turn interaction is closed by IdleGapDetector (RFC 0020 §B). Threaded into InteractionTracker at runtime startup.

enabled.description: Whether the agent can use memory tools (store_note, etc.)

max_notes.description: Per-agent note cap; oldest low-access notes pruned when exceeded

auto_reflect_after.description: Inject reflection nudge after N interactions

inject_recent_notes.description: Number of most relevant notes to include in context per LLM call

retention_days.description: Hard-delete compressed episodes older than this many days (per E7.2)

decay_rate.description: Per-cycle trust decay rate toward neutral (0.5). Higher values cause faster trust erosion without reinforcement.

shared_memory_pool.description: RFC 0008 PR plan PR 4: ACL + retention settings for one named shared pool. Reader and writer ACLs are deny-by-default.

readers.description: Agent IDs allowed to read from this pool. Deny-by-default — agents not listed raise SharedMemoryPermissionError.

writers.description: Agent IDs allowed to write into this pool. Deny-by-default.

max_entries.description: Maximum entries retained in the pool. FIFO eviction on `created_at` ascending when exceeded — RFC 0008 PR plan PR 4 documents why §G hybrid scoring does not apply to shared pools.

required_confidence.description: Writers must supply `confidence >= required_confidence`; lower values are rejected at write time.

sensitive.description: When true, `MemoryFacade.publish_to_pool` rejects all writes regardless of writer ACL — RFC 0008 §H safety constraint #3.
